description.text: The promos of the Mega Evolution Series, numbered from 001 and released since September 2025, starting with the Mega Evolution expansion and its products. Most come in collections, boxes, blisters, tins and Elite Trainer Boxes, and in each expansion's Build & Battle Box with a staff copy for prerelease staff. The 30th Celebration products brought a long run of their own, and the set also holds the 2026 World Championships' Paradise Resort and Pikachu for the Worlds Celebration events. The set is still growing.

description.text: The 2025 print of Celebratory Fanfare, the end-of-season card Japan and the rest of Asia had given since 2021, here first printed in English, with Yuu Nishida's art. Players in North America, Europe and Oceania who reached Ace Trainer status with 200 Championship Points in the 2024-2025 season, in the card game, the video games or Pokémon GO, were sent a copy with "Ace Trainer" in gold foil, shipped by 31 January 2026; players of the 2024-2025 Asia Championship Series picked up copies with its logo at events of the next season. In Japan the same art is 033/M-P. The date listed for this card, 31 January 2026, is that shipping deadline, as no source says when the first copies went out.

A copy with the Asia Championship Series 2024-25 logo, the end-of-season reward for players in other Asian markets who earned enough points in the 2024-2025 Asia Championship Series (1 September 2024 to 31 August 2025). They picked it up at Ultra Ball League events of the next season.

The foil Mega Charizard X ex of one of the two Mega Charizard Tins of 20 February 2026, with four booster packs and a code card; the other tin held Mega Charizard Y ex 030. The print, with takuyoa's art, was first a Traditional Chinese promo in Taiwan and Hong Kong, in the Inferno X Value Set. The Mega Charizard X ex promo of the Ultra-Premium Collection is another card, Saboteri's 023.
This promo came in the Mega Charizard Tins.

Paradise Resort was the promo card of the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in San Francisco, held from 28 to 30 August 2026 and the first Worlds split across two venues, the Moscone Center for the main event and the Chase Center for Championship Sunday. Naoki Saito's art features Gimmighoul, Psyduck, Sudowoodo, Klawf, Fidough, Charjabug, Spheal, Archaludon and Sylveon; it was revealed in June 2026 along with the competitors' welcome kits. Competitors received the card, staff got a Staff copy, and the top finishers got copies stamped with their placement.

The 2026 print of Celebratory Fanfare with Yuu Nishida's art, the end-of-season reward of the 2025-2026 season. Ace Trainers, players who earned 200 Championship Points in the card game, the video games or Pokémon GO, get a copy with "Ace Trainer" in gold foil and a Play! Pokémon logo, shipped by 31 January 2027, with Latin America now included through copies handed out at Regional and Special Championships; in Malaysia, the Philippines and Singapore copies have the "Pokémon Game On!" logo. In Japan the same art is 147/M-P. The date listed for this card, 31 January 2027, is that shipping deadline, as no source says when the first copies go out.

tell.text: The Play! Pokémon logo stamped on the card, usually at the bottom right of the picture.

description.text:
A Pikachu given to finishers of Pokémon RUN 30, noncompetitive fun runs held in seven Asian regions from October 2026 to January 2027 for Pokémon's 30th anniversary. Runners pick a first partner, tackle Gym-themed obstacles and collect stickers along the course, and every verified finisher can collect one card. Pokémon revealed it on 2 September 2026: a 60 HP Lightning Pikachu in a red running cap racing through a tropical landscape, with a Pokémon RUN stamp over the art.

This English print went to finishers in the Philippines (3 and 4 October 2026, SM Mall of Asia), Singapore (7 and 8 November, The Kallang) and Malaysia (21 and 22 November, KLCC). Pokémon has said the card may also be given out at other events.

An oversize-only promo drawn by Naoyo Kimura for "Pokécology", the Pokémon × Natural History Museum pop-up in the museum's Cranbourne Boutique in London from 26 January to 19 April 2026. It was given, one per customer, with purchases at the pop-up, never sold or offered online, and from 30 January 2026 with purchases at some UK shops; it was not available from the Pokémon Center.

description.text: An oversize-only card, given with purchases of Pokémon × Natural History Museum merchandise at the exhibition's pop-up shop in the Natural History Museum, London, from 26 January to 19 April 2026, and at some UK shops from 30 January 2026.
